summary: Reed's, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026 reporting a second amendment to its Senior Secured Loan and Security Agreement with Whitebox Advisors affiliates and Cantor Fitzgerald as administrative and collateral agent. The amendment terminates the existing revolving commitments and converts them into a $9.25 million new term loan tranche, raises interest to 8.75% per annum, extends maturity to June 30, 2027 with an optional three-month extension to September 30, 2027 subject to conditions, eliminates the unused fee, and waives the liquidity covenant through November 6, 2026. The company must receive at least $10 million of aggregate cash equity contributions by November 6, 2026 or trigger an Event of Default. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch the looming equity raise as the key credit-risk event.
